$comment: StageBench demo v2: `node scripts/make.mjs --show shows/demo-v2-alla-turca.json`. Models play in the listed order: by live rank, lowest first, ending on #1 (round 5). The list is kept by hand rather than `"order": "countdown"`, so a rank change can never silently move a model onto a phrase it wasn't recorded for; --plan warns when the list and the live ranks disagree, and compose refuses a take recorded for other bars. failOnMiss: a take with any missed note fails (and is retried) instead of reaching compose. Ranks are computed at plan/compose time from src/data/runs.json, the gallery's combined leaderboard; never write them here. A model that can't be filmed yet (no run record or no stage-3 preview in this checkout) is a placeholder slot: its bars stay in the plan and compose fills them with a label card until it is recorded (README 'Placeholders'). previewBase "local" serves this checkout's public/ (scripts/lib/serve.mjs). Cut: 8-bar phrases from the A-minor theme's return (bar 129) to the end of the janissary march, every turn one phrase on screen. pickupInIntro: the first model's picture starts on bar 129's downbeat like every other turn, and its idle and one-beat pickup play under the end of the intro. The last model stops on the march's A-major cadence (bar 192, beat 1: lastBarBeats), holds that chord 0.6 s (finalHold), and its picture runs 0.55 s past the release (breathe), the last 0.35 s of it a crossfade into the end card (endCard.crossfade); the reverb tail rings on under the card and fades out (ringOut). intro: the real Nord Stage 4 photo (assets/nord-stage-4-on-black.png, keyed by scripts/key-photo.mjs from the wustep.me photo) placed on the first model's chassis as composed (frame "first-model"), with the title and subtitle above it and the date below. endCard: the StageBench keyboard from wustep.me (assets/stagebench-keyboard.svg) at 8x its 132x50 size with the site's drop shadow, then the title and the link. Card type and layout are house style in scripts/compose.mjs.
